name: computer-use
description: Codex-style computer use for Claude Code. Drives Windows and macOS apps through the accessibility tree instead of screenshots, so it targets exactly, survives display scaling, and costs about 20x fewer tokens. Knows your input from its own, so you can keep working on the same desktop while it works. WARNING: controls your real computer - read the README.

blocked_apps.title: Additional blocked apps
blocked_apps.description: Comma-separated process names Computer Use must never read or drive, on top of its built-in blocklist. Example: myvault,internal-admin

coexist_mode.title: Coexistence mode
coexist_mode.description: share = wait for a gap in your typing before using the cursor (recommended). yield = refuse while you are active. take = interrupt you.

user_idle_ms.title: Idle threshold (ms)
user_idle_ms.description: How long you must be quiet before Computer Use considers the machine free.
